citation: Holm MB et al. Uptake and release of amino acids in the fetal-placental unit in human pregnancies. PLoS ONE. 2017;12(10):e0185760. doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0185760.

version_of_record_pdf_visual_review.locator: Table 2, Alanine row, Uterine vein column
version_of_record_pdf_visual_review.disposition: The lower-quartile glyph is visibly a printed digit 2. Retain the literal as published; whether it is an authoring or production error remains unresolved.

version_of_record_pdf_table2_text_reconc.method: Extract Table 2's ordered median/Q1/Q3 numeric groups from the publisher PDF text layer and compare with the XML-derived aggregate CSV; normalize whitespace and compare exact Decimal values.
version_of_record_pdf_table2_text_reconc.limitations: This is a PDF text-layer cross-check against the XML-derived ledger, not participant-level validation or an independent statistical recalculation. The flagged cell's printed glyph was separately checked in the rendered page image.

version_of_record_pdf_table3_text_reconc.extractor: pypdf 6.10.0; pdfplumber 0.11.9 for cell font metadata
version_of_record_pdf_table3_text_reconc.method: Extract the ordered Table 3 median/Q1/Q3 groups and immediately following printed p-value literals from the publisher PDF text layer; compare to the XML-derived paired-difference CSV, normalizing whitespace and comparing exact Decimal values and p-value strings.
version_of_record_pdf_table3_text_reconc.bold_marker_method: For each of the 76 summary-cell bounding boxes, classify embedded font Helvetica-Bold as bold and Helvetica as regular; compare with the XML-derived ledger marker.
version_of_record_pdf_table3_text_reconc.limitations: Font metadata corroborates the table's printed bold style but does not independently reproduce the FDR procedure. XML-derived bold/FDR markers remain preserved as the intake source; no p-values or FDR results were recalculated.

table2.N_scope: vessel-header N, not asserted analyte-specific or paired

table3.n_scope: one source-reported N per circulation, not asserted analyte-specific

evidence_class.study_population: 179 healthy women with uncomplicated singleton term pregnancies
evidence_class.sampling_context: planned cesarean delivery; maternal radial artery and uterine vein, fetal umbilical vein and artery
evidence_class.analysis_unit: individual in repository metadata; no participant-level file ingested

aggregate_table_intake.source_table: Table 2: Amino acid concentrations on the maternal and fetal sides of the placenta
aggregate_table_intake.sample_size_note: N is transcribed from the Table 2 vessel header row. It is not asserted to be an analyte-specific or paired comparison denominator.

source_cell_review_flags.status: unusual lower-quartile source literal preserved without correction
source_cell_review_flags.publisher_pdf_text_cross_check: The public PLOS version-of-record PDF text extraction repeats the same literal. This does not establish whether the printed glyph itself is a typo.

candidate_observation_intake.representation: author-reported median with typed Q1/Q3, source literal, vessel-level N and N scope

paired_difference_table_intake.source_table: Table 3: Crude and adjusted uteroplacental arteriovenous and umbilical venoarterial concentration differences with p-values
paired_difference_table_intake.sample_size_note: Table 3 reports one N per circulation. It is retained as printed and not asserted to be analyte-specific.
paired_difference_table_intake.interpretation_note: The table footnote defines bold differences as significant after FDR correction and says adjusted p-values for significant results are reported in the text. Printed p-values and bold status are preserved; no statistical result was recomputed.

candidate_paired_difference_intake.representation: author-reported median difference with typed Q1/Q3, exact source literal, printed p-value and source bold/FDR marker

descriptive_consistency_audit.consistency_note: Matches the article text's 14 positive differences and negative glutamic-acid difference after water-transfer adjustment and FDR reporting. Counts are descriptive checks of published medians and source formatting, not a recalculation of the statistical analysis.

availability_by_field.vessel_concentrations: group medians and quartiles publicly available in Table 2 and transcribed in the aggregate CSV
availability_by_field.paired_arteriovenous_differences: aggregate crude and water-adjusted summaries publicly available in Table 3 and transcribed in the paired-difference CSV
availability_by_field.participant_level_values: linked NSD record; latest V2 metadata restricts provision to agreement with principal investigator upon order; not accessed
availability_by_field.blood_flow: not present in inspected article tables or supplement

access_review.latest_record_restriction: Sikt can provide data in agreement with the principal investigator upon order.

scope_limit: Term human in-vivo amino-acid concentration reference only. Concentration differences are not fluxes without blood-flow data. The source does not establish ex-vivo perfusion performance, earlier-stage exchange, embryo support, continuous gestation, artificial-environment birth, or later health.
next_action: Retain only the public aggregate summary cells. Keep the restricted participant dataset out of intake and do not combine this in-vivo source with ex-vivo perfusion trajectories.
